role: Reading catalog and status scalar records
known_patches: Integer identity schemas and synthetic source persona
Original source semantics bounded by actual probes
limitations: All 47 source tools retained; nine declared tools certify Edition, Shelf, generic Status and ReadThrough scalar records.

book_search reads Book while book_create/book_edit operate Edition; no inheritance/join synchronization or newly created Edition discoverability is certified. Book.description carrier is read from actual Book rows.
status_type does not create Comment/Review/Quotation subtype rows or save rating/quote/progress inputs; only generic Status.content metadata certified.
Source trusted-editor and own-status messages are stronger than actual guards, which only require active User. Shelf delete checks vary; no comprehensive authorization claim.

No source shelf/status/readthrough read/list interface. shelf_create omits identifier generation; annualgoal existing upsert ignores goal replacement. No complete reading workflow, recurrence, federation or publication delivery.
